intro.title: First Unique Character
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that finds the first non-repeating character in a given string. You will learn how to use a hash map (or object) to efficiently count character frequencies. The main technologies involved are JavaScript strings, loops, and objects. This exercise will help you practice basic data structure manipulation and problem-solving with simple algorithms.
intro.usecase: Finding the first unique character is a fundamental pattern for validating user input and processing text streams in real-world applications. For example, when a user submits a form, you might need to check if a username or email address contains any duplicate characters that violate naming rules, ensuring data integrity before saving to a database. In interactive dashboards, this algorithm can help highlight the first non-repeating item in a live feed of notifications or log entries, allowing users to quickly identify new or unique events. It's also used in text editors or IDEs for syntax highlighting or linting, where detecting the first unique symbol in a code block can assist in debugging or code analysis.
